title.zh: SemiAnalysis：字节占中国近1/5数据中心容量，几乎全靠租
title.en: SemiAnalysis：字节占中国近1/5数据中心容量，几乎全靠租

current_state.zh: SemiAnalysis finds ByteDance is China's largest data-center tenant with over 4GW leased capacity — roughly a fifth of the country's expected 24GW by end-2026 — and is accelerating self-built AI campuses as advanced chip supply, not power or permitting, becomes the main bottleneck.
